topics.headline: Oil shock post-June dip raises odds both CPI and HICP rise next
topics.summary: US CPI (3.5%) and Eurozone HICP (2.8%) both fell last month, but renewed Iran conflict has pushed gasoline toward $4/gallon and oil to $86, leading economists across the board to expect both readings to reverse higher at their next releases.

topics.headline: HY spreads near record tights, but momentum points modestly wider
topics.summary: US HY OAS sits at ~2.69%, still deep in "late-cycle complacency" territory, yet multiple desks note spreads have started creeping up alongside equity wobbles and a stark CCC-vs-BB bifurcation; base case is modest further widening over 30 days, though 2025's precedent shows such moves can reverse quickly absent a real credit event.

topics.headline: BTC ETF flows choppy: week running -$135.8M despite recent positive days
topics.summary: Bitcoin ETFs posted three straight positive sessions (July 14-16) totaling ~$369M, but the current week is still net negative at -$135.77M, and Citi just cut its BTC target to $82K citing weak flows — suggesting fragile, unconfirmed momentum rather than a durable inflow trend.

topics.headline: VIX at 16.73 sits below its likely-elevated 3-month average
topics.summary: VIX jumped 6.76% to 16.73 on oil/Hormuz fears, but with April averaging 19.31 and March peaking above 31, the trailing 3-month average is likely still higher than current spot—meaning VIX may need a fresh shock (tariff-court fallout, Section 301 probes, Hormuz escalation) just to close the gap, let alone exceed it in 30 days.

topics.headline: Chevron-Microsoft 2.67GW Texas PPA anchors accelerating hyperscaler power deal cadence
topics.summary: On June 22, 2026 Chevron's Energy Forge One signed a 20-year PPA with Microsoft for a 2.67GW co-located Texas facility (Project Kilby), the most concrete recent deal amid a broader pattern of near-monthly hyperscaler power agreements (Talen/Amazon, TotalEnergies/Google, Digital Realty) that makes another qualifying announcement within 30 days highly likely.
